title: WorkersAnswerParams
description: Parameters for the workers.answer agent tool: answer a question one of your workers' panes is asking, by naming the option exactly as its screen shows it. nocx turns the name into the keys that menu offers and refuses an option that is not on the screen; it never picks one for you. You can only answer workers your own session started, and not while a person is at that worker's keyboard.

worker.description: The worker's id, exactly as workers.spawn returned it or workers.holdings listed it.

option.description: The option to choose, as the worker's screen shows it — for example `Yes, I trust this folder`. Leave off the selection marker and any number in front of it: `1. Yes` is chosen as `Yes`.

result.title: WorkersAnswerResult
result.description: What became of the answer, and — when this answer was also the moment a task from workers.spawn was still owed — what became of that task. A refusal is an answer too: nothing was written, and the reason says why.

worker.description: The worker whose menu this was.

outcome.description: submitted: the option was chosen and confirmed. typed: the selection was moved and nothing was confirmed — look at the screen again before deciding anything. refused: nothing was written at all.

state.description: The state the worker's pane was in when the answer was decided.

reason.description: Why, when the answer was not confirmed.

delivery.description: typed: the task from workers.spawn reached this pane and started the worker's turn — you do not need to send it again. waiting: this answer confirmed, but the pane is now asking something else; look at it with workers.screen and answer that with workers.answer too, and the task follows automatically once a confirmed answer finds the pane ready. refused: nocx's typing gate turned the task away, or the worker's agent exited before it could be paid — see reason.

state.description: The pane state the task's own delivery was decided against, when there is one to name.

task.description: Present only when this answer's own confirmation was the moment a task workers.spawn left owed got its chance to be typed. Absent for every other answer — including one that only moved a selection, one the gate refused outright, or one confirmed by a worker that owed nothing.
